caption: The drawing depicts a woman standing and holding a pink rose in her right hand. She is dressed in an elaborate gown featuring a fitted bodice and a wide, floor-length skirt. The outer part of the dress is brown and covered in a colorful floral pattern with blue, red, green, and white flowers and vines. The inner panel of the skirt is a pale, off-white color with a large, subtle floral damask pattern. The sleeves are three-quarter length with white ruffled lace cuffs, and the neckline is low with a white lace trim. The woman has blonde, wavy hair that is styled up, and she is wearing a black choker necklace and a bracelet on her left wrist. To the right of the figure, there are additional small drawings of flowers in red, blue, and green, similar to those on the dress. The paper is a light beige color, and the signature "Lillian Causey" appears in the lower right corner.
title: Dress
